obligations.expected_behavior: A replay from a fresh checkout using pinned inputs reproduces the terminal semantic verdict deterministically.
forbidden_result: The replay produces a different terminal semantic verdict for the same pinned inputs.
The replay cannot determine or reproduce the terminal semantic verdict.
obligations.observable_result: The fresh-checkout replay's terminal semantic verdict matches the verdict determined by the pinned inputs.
obligations.state_after: The terminal semantic verdict has been reproduced from the fresh checkout and pinned inputs.
obligations.state_before: A fresh checkout is available and the replay inputs are pinned.
obligations.subject: Terminal semantic verdict reproduction
obligations.trigger: When replay is run from a fresh checkout with pinned inputs.

obligations.expected_behavior: A replay from a fresh checkout using pinned inputs reproduces the Exact Cover deterministically.
forbidden_result: The replay produces a different or incomplete Exact Cover for the same pinned inputs.
The replay cannot determine or reproduce the Exact Cover.
obligations.observable_result: The fresh-checkout replay's Exact Cover matches the Exact Cover determined by the pinned inputs.
obligations.state_after: The Exact Cover has been reproduced from the fresh checkout and pinned inputs.
obligations.state_before: A fresh checkout is available and the replay inputs are pinned.
obligations.subject: Exact Cover reproduction
obligations.trigger: When replay is run from a fresh checkout with pinned inputs.
